metadata.question: Was the area of forest cover between the Ucayali and Genepanshea Rivers larger along UC-105, at 5 km radius around center (-9.799994, -73.845369), on August 21, 2022 than on August 23, 2017?

data.raw_code: The user is asking to compare forest cover area between two dates (August 21, 2022 vs August 23, 2017) in a 5km radius circle around a specific coordinate along UC-105 between the Ucayali and Genepanshea Rivers. For forest cover analysis, I should: 1. Use Sentinel-2 imagery which has good vegetation monitoring capabilities 2. Calculate NDVI as a proxy for forest cover (NDVI > 0.5-0.6 typically indicates vegetation/forest) 3. Create a 5km radius circle around the given coordinate 4. Compare the area of high NDVI pixels between the two dates I need to: - Check if collections are empty for either date (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after cloud masking (C2) - Validate the results aren't None/NaN (C3) - Compare the forest areas and output A/B I'll use: - Sentinel-2 Surface Reflectance (COPERNICUS/S2_SR) - NDVI calculation: (B8 - B4) / (B8 + B4) - Forest threshold: NDVI > 0.6 - Cloud masking using QA60 band ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const center = ee.Geometry.Point([-73.845369, -9.799994]); const roi = center.buffer(5000); // 5km radius // Date ranges (single day for each) const date2017 = '2017-08-23'; const date2022 = '2022-08-21'; // 2. Data Acquisition function getForestImage(date) { const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')); if (collection.size().getInfo() === 0) return null; // Get least cloudy image and mask clouds const image = collection.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); const masked = image.updateMask(mask); // Calculate NDVI and forest mask const ndvi = masked.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); const forest = ndvi.gt(0.6); // Forest threshold return forest; } const forest2017 = getForestImage(date2017); const forest2022 = getForestImage(date2022); // Check for empty collections if (!forest2017 || !forest2022) { const count2017 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date2017, ee.Date(date2017).advance(1, 'day')) .size().getInfo(); const count2022 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date2022, ee.Date(date2022).advance(1, 'day')) .size().getInfo(); print(`2017 Images: ${count2017}, 2022 Images: ${count2022}`); print("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate forest areas function calculateForestArea(forestImg, date) { const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); // Area in m² // Count forest pixels and calculate area const forestArea = forestImg.multiply(pixelArea); const stats = forestArea.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area = stats.get('NDVI').getInfo(); const pixelCount = forestImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); return {area: area, pixels: pixelCount}; } const area2017 = calculateForestArea(forest2017, '2017'); const area2022 = calculateForestArea(forest2022, '2022'); // Check for no valid pixels if (area2017.pixels === 0 || area2022.pixels === 0) { print(`2017 Forest Pixels: ${area2017.pixels}, 2022 Forest Pixels: ${area2022.pixels}`); print("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failure if (area2017.area === null || area2022.area === null || isNaN(area2017.area) || isNaN(area2022.area)) { print("C3"); return; } // 4. Compare and output result print(`2017 Forest Area: ${(area2017.area / 1e6).toFixed(2)} km² (Pixels: ${area2017.pixels})`); print(`2022 Forest Area: ${(area2022.area / 1e6).toFixed(2)} km² (Pixels: ${area2022.pixels})`); if (area2022.area > area2017.area) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
